hook.line: At its narrowest the Strait of Hormuz is twenty-one miles across.
hook.idea: the single strongest image in the story, held tight
hook.demands: the strongest, most specific image available — never a texture, never a stand-in

ending.line: Twenty-one miles of water, and there is no substitute for any of it.
ending.idea: the closing claim, typographic and still
ending.demands: one shot: the strongest relevant image, the claim over it, then a hold and a hard out
